ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) reported the seizure of approximately INR 5.69 Lakhs worth of goods by the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) due to an industry-wide customs tariff classification dispute for bulk scotch imports. Although the company states there is no material business disruption and expects an early resolution due to government engagement, this regulatory action highlights a potential compliance risk concerning import practices that could impact future costs if the industry-wide issue is not resolved favorably.
